decision.title: The QT4 driver: catalog and environments (packet )
decision.summary: The QT4 driver sxml-qt4 reads the catalog and test sets through the public API into arena trees, resolves environments, decides applicability by dependency tables, and lists test cases.

body.p: . tests/qt4/driver/, the developer tool sxml-qt4 on the CLI framework (), public API only.

item.p: Reading: catalog.xml and test-set files go through sxml_xml_parser_parse into an arena tree (own name pool, type registry, item heap) and are walked with the public node accessors; only elements in the catalog namespace count. One catalog object (lifecycle quintet; load makes the parts, initialize allocates nothing) keeps catalog.xml and one open test set; a test case's views and arrays live until the next open_test_set (a per-test-set arena). File paths are suite paths: relative to catalog.xml's directory, dot segments removed (RFC 3986 5.2.4), so output is the same wherever the suite is and under WASI.

Environments: ref looks in the test set first, then the catalog; an environment element without ref is inline even with a name (<environment name="empty"/>); no element means absent. All children of catalog-schema.xsd are read (sources, params with as, namespaces, context item, static base URI with #UNDEFINED, resources, collections, collations, decimal formats, schemas, function library, sandpit, modules).

Applicability (first failing rule is the skip reason): spec as tools/check-test-list.py (case spec replaces set spec; every value needs a matching token); every other dependency of set and case must be satisfied as asked, satisfied meaning one of its tokens is in a table: feature higherOrderFunctions and namespace-axis, xml-version 1.0 and 1.0:5+, xsd-version 1.1, limits big_integer and year_lt_0, language and default-language en; then the environment: source validation, schema, resource, collection, non-codepoint collation, decimal format, function library, sandpit; then modules. The table grows with sxml.

CLI: sxml-qt4 list [--catalog=FILE] [--spec=XP40|XQ40] [--test-set=NAME] [TEST-LIST] (default catalog third_party/qt4tests/catalog.xml; neither selection means the whole catalog; both is a usage error). Text blocks per test case, summary line; problems on stderr, exit 1/3/4 as sxml check. Packet adds run with assertion.c and report.c; the library target globs the directory, so it needs no CMake edit for new modules.

Tests: ctest (unit tests over in-memory files, allocation-failure loop) and qt4/* golden tests over a small suite in tests/qt4/driver/input/ and the slice (qt4/list_slice: 198/198 resolve and apply to XP40).
